lines.en: And so another[school] day comes to a close.
lines.zh: 于是，又一个[school]的日子落幕了。

lines.en: Originally, the plan was for me to go to karaoke again with Ami, Ayane, and Maya but...
lines.zh: 原本的计划是跟 Ami、Ayane 和 Maya 再去一次卡拉OK，但是……

lines.en: Well, one of the three (And I’m sure you can guess which one) succeeded in un-inviting me this time.
lines.zh: 嗯，三个人里的某一个（我敢说你猜得到是哪一个）这次成功地把我从邀请名单里剔除了。

lines.en: As it turns out, Maya can be incredibly persuasive when she wants to be.
lines.zh: 事实证明，Maya 想要说服别人的时候，说服力惊人。

lines.en: I guess I must just be immune to her powers or something, though, because she hasn’t managed to dissuade me from visiting her yet.
lines.zh: 不过我猜我对她的能力免疫之类的，因为她至今还没能拦住我去找她。

lines.en: But, either way, now I’m alone and wandering the streets, trying to find some way to kill the time.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，现在我一个人闲逛在街上，想找点事打发时间。

lines.en: "I’ve gotten bored of choosing between the dorms, the bar, and the porn shop (Seriously, when am I
lines.zh: 「我已经在宿舍、酒吧和成人用品店之间挑腻了（说真的，我什么时候

lines.en: going to have something else to do after class?) and so now I’m just..."
lines.zh: 放学后才有别的事可做？），所以现在我就是在……」
谁知道呢？

lines.en: I’m just walking around. Life is good.
lines.zh: 我就是随便走走。生活很美好。

lines.en: And by good I mean passable.
lines.zh: 我说的美好，是指还过得去。
没错。
生活还过得去。
这话你可是第一个听说的。

lines.en: : Ooooh, who is that cute boy I spot off in the distance?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我远远看到的那个可爱男孩是谁呀？

lines.en: I turn around to find Sara and...Haruka hanging out at the same bistro that Ami and Maya frequent?
lines.zh: 我转过身，发现 Sara 和……Haruka 居然一起待在 Ami 和 Maya 常去的那家小餐馆？
: 嘿。你们在干什么？

lines.en: : The two of us are just catching up on old times. Fancy meeting you here~
lines.zh: : 我们两个正在叙旧呢。在这儿碰见你真巧~
: 彼此彼此……嘿，Haruka。怎么样？

lines.en: : Hey! I’m surprised you two know each other.
lines.zh: : 嘿！没想到你们两个认识。

lines.en: : I was actually just thinking the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我刚才也正想说同样的话。

lines.en: : {i}He’s the one I was telling you about on the phone...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他就是我在电话里跟你提过的那个……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Huh? The one you were telling me about on the-{i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈？你在电话里跟我提过的那个——{/i}
: 你该不会……

lines.en: : Whaaaat? Girls talk about stuff~ Are you embarrassed of me?
lines.zh: : 什么嘛~女孩子之间聊聊天而已~你觉得丢人了吗？

lines.en: Haruka’s clearly flustered or embarrassed or...shocked. I don’t know. Haruka is something.
lines.zh: Haruka 显然是慌了、害羞了，还是震惊了。我不知道。Haruka 就是有点那个。

lines.en: I hope this doesn’t change her opinion of me too much.
lines.zh: 希望这不会让她对我的印象改变太多。

lines.en: : If it makes you feel any better, I only had good things to say~
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，我说的可都是你的好话~
: 是啊……{i}非常{/i}好的话……
: 你吃醋了？

lines.en: : N-no! I’m just surprised! You would be too if you found out two people you see all the time have been...you know.
lines.zh: : 才、才没有！我只是惊讶！要是你发现两个经常见面的人一直在……你知道的，你也会惊讶的。
: 上床？

lines.en: : You haven’t changed at all since [high_school], have you?...
lines.zh: : 你从[high_school]到现在一点都没变，是吧？……
: 你们两个是[high_school]同学？
: 没错。
: 他是我女儿的[high_school]老师。

lines.en: : Oh, really? She must be in the same class as one of my employees then.
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？那她一定跟我某个员工同班了。

lines.en: : Oooh is that so? Can you tell us if those two are friends or not?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，是吗？那你能不能告诉我们，那两个孩子是不是朋友？

lines.en: : I haven’t heard Sana talk about anyone other than you and the blonde girl, so I’m starting to worry that she’s a bit of a wallflower.
lines.zh: : 我从没听 Sana 提起过你和那个金发女孩以外的人，所以我都开始担心她有点太内向了。
她提到这个，倒是挺巧的……

lines.en: Sana and Rin sit right next to each other and I feel like the two of them would get along if they actually talked.
lines.zh: Sana 和 Rin 就坐在一起，我觉得她们两个要是真聊起来，应该会合得来。

lines.en: I know both of them play games and...wear mostly black so like...
lines.zh: 我知道她们两个都玩游戏，而且……穿得多半是黑色，所以就……

lines.en: They’d be destined to be good friends, right? Is that how it works?
lines.zh: 她们注定会成为好朋友，对吧？事情就是这么运作的吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think they are. But maybe I’ll try to push them together if I ever have the chance.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们不是。不过要是有机会，我也许会试着把她们推到一起。

lines.en: : Please do! Sana needs all the help she can get.
lines.zh: : 一定要啊！Sana 需要一切能得到的帮助。

lines.en: : She definitely seems a little more outgoing lately thanks to you, though...
lines.zh: : 不过多亏了你，她最近看起来确实开朗了一点……

lines.en: : Yeah, Rin too when she’s not...you know.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Rin 也是，在她不……你知道的时候。
: 哦，我知道……

lines.en: : How do you two know each other, by the way?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你们两个是怎么认识的？
: 高中啊！

lines.en: : Really? Were you in the same class or something?
lines.zh: : 真的？你们是同班还是什么？
: 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Haru was a few years ahead of me but the two of us used to hang out with some of the same people.
lines.zh: : Haru 比我高几届，但我们以前跟同一群人混。

lines.en: : And now we’re both running small businesses. Who’d have thought things would turn out like this?
lines.zh: : 现在我们两个都经营着自己的小店。谁能想到事情会变成这样呢？

lines.en: : Of course Haruka’s is taking off while mine is imploding, though...
lines.zh: : 当然了，Haruka 的店蒸蒸日上，而我的正在原地爆炸……

lines.en: : Oh, stop. We’re not taking off...Besides, I’m sure the bar will get better in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。我们才没有蒸蒸日上……再说了，我敢肯定酒吧很快就会好起来的。

lines.en: : Please spend all of your money there. I need it.
lines.zh: : 请把你所有的钱都花在那儿吧。我需要钱。

lines.en: : Well...I can’t spend {i}all{/i} of my money there...I still have bills and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可不能把{i}所有{/i}的钱都花在那儿……我还有账单什么的要付。

lines.en: : Sensei~ Tell Haru-chan to be nice and spend all of her money on me...
lines.zh: : 老师~你让 Haru 酱对我好一点，把她的钱都花在我身上嘛……

lines.en: : Um...Why do you call him Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你为什么叫他老师？……

lines.en: : You should try it! It’s actually pretty fun. It makes me feel [young]again.
lines.zh: : 你也该试试！其实挺好玩的。这让我觉得自己又[young]了。
: 可你{i}本来{/i}就很年轻啊……

lines.en: : Just do it! Come on! I promise, you’ll love it.
lines.zh: : 试试嘛！来吧！我保证你会喜欢的。

lines.en: Haruka makes eye contact with me, trying to figure out if this is an acceptable thing for her to do or not.
lines.zh: Haruka 与我四目相对，试图判断这么做对她来说合不合适。
坦白说，我不在乎。

lines.en: I’ve gotten used to everyone calling me Sensei over the last few months anyway.
lines.zh: 反正这几个月来，我已经习惯了所有人都叫我老师。

lines.en: : Nope. Can’t do it. We’re like the same age. It feels weird.
lines.zh: : 不行。做不到。我们差不多是同龄人。感觉好奇怪。

lines.en: : Come on! It’s like roleplay! I thought you were into stuff like that!
lines.zh: : 来嘛！就像角色扮演一样！我还以为你喜欢那种东西呢！
: 萨……Sara！你他妈说什么？！
: 嘿嘿嘿~哎呀……

lines.en: : Please forget that you just heard that. It’s not true. I swear.
lines.zh: : 请忘记你刚刚听到的话。那不是真的。我发誓。

lines.en: : Really? I don’t think there’s any shame in roleplay. It can actually be kind of fun at times.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我觉得角色扮演没什么好丢人的。有时候其实还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Oh-ho-ho...What an interesting development this has turned out to be...
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵呵……事情的发展变得有趣起来了呢……

lines.en: : Greetings once more, attractive human females. How is-
lines.zh: : 又见面了，迷人的女性人类们。请问——
: 啊！又是你！
: 汉堡人！
: 汉堡人？……

lines.en: : I ordered a hamburger from some diner she works at once.
lines.zh: : 我曾经在她打工的某家餐厅点过一个汉堡。

lines.en: : You said strange things to me!
lines.zh: : 你对我说了奇怪的话！
: 我可没说过那种话……
: 你说过！
: 我没有……
: 你有！

lines.en: : My, you’re pretty popular around here, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你在这儿还挺受欢迎的嘛？
: 大概吧……

lines.en: : Greetings once more, attractive human females. Is there anything else I can get for you?
lines.zh: : 又见面了，迷人的女性人类们。还有什么我能为你们效劳的吗？

lines.en: A girl, probably a few years older than Ami, crouches down at the table and checks on Sara and Haruka, albeit in a rather...strange manner.
lines.zh: 一个大概比 Ami 大几岁的女孩蹲在桌边，查看 Sara 和 Haruka 的情况，只是方式相当……奇怪。

lines.en: I’m surprised that this place would hire someone with a tattoo as huge as that on her chest.
lines.zh: 我很惊讶这家店会雇一个胸口纹着那么大一片纹身的人。

lines.en: Not that I have anything against tattoos, it's just sort of frowned upon in Japan.
lines.zh: 倒不是我对纹身有什么意见，只是在日本这多少有点被人忌讳。

lines.en: : I think we’re okay for now, Kaori. Please keep up the good work.
lines.zh: : 我们暂时不需要，Kaori。请继续保持这股干劲。
: 我也不用了。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : You! With the face. Order food now.
lines.zh: : 你！那个脸的。现在点餐。
: 我们都有脸啊……

lines.en: : Your face is different! It interests me!
lines.zh: : 你的脸不一样！我对你很感兴趣！

lines.en: k "Now order food so that I may receive money from my employer that I can
lines.zh: k 「现在点餐，这样我就能从雇主那里拿到钱，

lines.en: then use to purchase normal human objects like a “spatula” and a “dog-food.”"
lines.zh: 然后用它去购买『锅铲』和『狗粮』这种正常的人类物品。」
: {i}一份{/i}狗粮？

lines.en: : Yes. I can not obtain a “dog” until I have the nutrients required to nurture it.
lines.zh: : 对。在获得养育「狗」所需的营养之前，我无法得到一只「狗」。

lines.en: : Why are you putting quotation marks around everything?
lines.zh: : 你为什么给所有东西都加上引号？
: 点餐，或者死……
: 我要一个汉堡。
: 你当然会要……

lines.en: : Kaori will collect this item for you...Please prepare the currency you will use in exchange for it.
lines.zh: : Kaori 这就去为你取这件物品……请准备好用于交换的货币。
: 谢了……

lines.en: : She’s a little, uhh, eccentric...don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 她有点，呃，古怪……你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I like her. I think she’s fun.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她。我觉得她很有意思。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m fully convinced that she’s human yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不完全确信她是人类。

lines.en: : Same. I like her tattoo, though. I wish I could pull off something like that.
lines.zh: : 同感。不过我喜欢她的纹身。我要是也能驾驭那种东西就好了。

lines.en: : You totally could. Maybe not a spider but like...I don’t know. A sparrow or something?
lines.zh: : 你绝对可以。也许不是蜘蛛，但比如……我不知道。麻雀什么的？

lines.en: : No way. My boobs are too big. It would look like a pterodactyl.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我的胸太大了。那看起来会像只翼龙。

lines.en: : Maybe I could get something on my thigh, though...That might be cute.
lines.zh: : 不过也许我可以在大腿上纹一个……那样可能挺可爱的。

lines.en: : What do you think? Do you like tattoos on women?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？你喜欢女生身上有纹身吗？
当然喜欢
: 哦，当然。我爱死了。
: 真的？

lines.en: : Yup. If you want one, I say go for it. You’re already attractive, so I imagine a tattoo would make you even hotter.
lines.zh: : 嗯。如果你想要一个，我说就去吧。你本来就很迷人，所以我想纹身会让你更火辣。

lines.en: : Hey...I want attention too, you know.
lines.zh: : 嘿……我也想要关注啊，你知道的。
不太喜欢

lines.en: : Ehh...I’m not really a fan. I think girls are more attractive when they don’t modify their bodies.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不太喜欢。我觉得女生不改造自己的身体更有魅力。

lines.en: : Hahaha...I think they can work on certain people. I just don’t think I’m cut out for one.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……我觉得有些人身上是合适的。我只是觉得自己不适合。

lines.en: sar "Aaaaaanyway, I hate to be the bearer of bad news but Haru and I still have a bunch of girl-talk we need to be doing, so I
lines.zh: sar 「那个那个，我也不想当坏消息的传播者，但我和 Haru 还有一堆

lines.en: think it might be time for you to shoo."
lines.zh: 女生之间的话要聊，所以我想你该退场了。」
: 你刚刚……是在赶我走？

lines.en: : Heheh~ I’ll make it up to you. Don’t worry...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~我会补偿你的。别担心……

lines.en: : I’m going to hold you to that.
lines.zh: : 我会记住你这句话的。
: 嗯……Sara 那么……{i}直白{/i}，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : You don’t need to apologize. I’m just happy knowing her daughter hasn’t taken after her.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉。我只是很高兴知道她女儿没有遗传她这一点。

lines.en: : Sensei is always so mean to me~
lines.zh: : 老师对我总是那么刻薄~
: Haru 酱，让他停下……

lines.en: : I...don’t think he’s going to listen to me...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得他不会听我的……

lines.en: I hang around until my burger arrives and then promptly have it boxed to take home.
lines.zh: 我一直待到汉堡上来，然后立刻打包带回家。

lines.en: It’s weird how two of the only people my age that I’ve associated with in Kumon-mi happen to be old friends from[school].
lines.zh: 真奇怪，我在 Kumon-mi 认识的仅有的几个同龄人里，居然有两个是[school]时代的老朋友。

lines.en: I think they work well together, though. Albeit in a strange sort of way.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得她们俩很合得来。虽然是以一种奇怪的方式。

lines.en: I wonder what the two of them were like back then?...
lines.zh: 我在想，她们两个那时候是什么样子呢？……
